title: Flows duck: state shape and reducer actions
answers: How does mitmweb store flows in Redux?
Why isn't the flows reducer createSlice?
body:
All under web/src/js/.
- `ducks/flows/index.ts:flowsReducer` is a hand-written reducer (not createSlice; Immer is too slow). Registered in `ducks/store.ts` and `flows` is in `serializableCheck.ignoredPaths` because state has Map/Set.
- State: `list` (arrival order), `_listIndex` (id->pos in list), `byId`, `view` (filtered+sorted), `_viewIndex`, `sort {column,desc}`, `selected: Flow[]`, `selectedIds`, `highlightedIds`.
- Server actions: FLOWS_ADD/UPDATE (`{flow, matching_filters}`), FLOWS_REMOVE, FLOWS_RECEIVE, FLOWS_FILTER_UPDATE (`{name, matching_flow_ids|null}`). Client: `setSort`, `select`.
- `ducks/flows/_backend_actions.ts` thunks (update, remove, mark, uploadContent...) only call REST; state changes return via websocket.
- Helpers in `ducks/flows/_utils.ts`: buildIndex, insertViewItem, updateViewItem, removeViewItemAt, findInsertPos; `_compat.ts` toSorted/toSpliced.
